tools.name: clearooms_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the Clearooms user that owns this API token: name, email, role and office. No scope needed. Clearooms API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: clearooms_list_offices
tools.description: List the offices this token may access, ordered by display order. Use the office ids with the desk and room tools. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /offices.

tools.name: clearooms_list_rooms
tools.description: List meeting rooms in the organisation. Give date and office_id to include each room's availability for that day. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /rooms.

tools.name: clearooms_get_room
tools.description: Get one meeting room by id: name, capacity, office and settings. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /rooms/{roomId}.

tools.name: clearooms_check_room_availability
tools.description: Check whether a meeting room can be booked at the given times on each date in a range, applying the room's rules. Extra rooms must all be free. Scope: meetings.manage. Clearooms API: GET /rooms/availability.

tools.name: clearooms_list_meetings
tools.description: List meetings on one date or across a date range. Dates are whole days in UTC, or in the office's timezone when office_id is given. Not paginated. Scope: meetings.read. Clearooms API: GET /meetings.

tools.name: clearooms_list_bookings
tools.description: List desk and parking bookings in the organisation for one day, a date range, or every booking active on a day. Bookings in disabled offices are left out unless the token is an admin's. Clearooms API: GET /bookings.

tools.name: clearooms_get_booking
tools.description: Get one desk or parking booking by id, with its times, desk, user and status. Clearooms API: GET /bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: clearooms_list_my_bookings
tools.description: List the bookings of the user who owns this token. Give date, or a from and to date-time range. Set unconfirmed to list only unconfirmed bookings. Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /users/me/bookings.

tools.name: clearooms_list_desks
tools.description: List desks and parking spaces in the organisation. Give office_id and date to get each desk's availability that day (this turns off search and sorting). Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /desks.

tools.name: clearooms_check_desk_availability
tools.description: Check whether a desk can be booked on each date from `from` to `to`, using the office's working hours unless start_time and end_time are given. Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /desks/availability.

tools.name: clearooms_get_bookings_report
tools.description: Get every booking that starts or ends between two dates, for reporting. Both dates may be the same day. Not paginated. Scope: reports.view. Clearooms API: GET /reports/bookings/{from}/{to}.

tools.name: clearooms_create_desk_booking
tools.description: Book a desk for the token's user, or for another user with user_id. Give date and end_date for consecutive days, or dates for specific slots. Clearooms only books dates that pass the availability checks; it returns HTTP 422 when none do. Scope: bookings.create.own (or bookings.create.others). Clearo

tools.name: clearooms_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a desk or parking booking by id, along with any bookings linked to it. Some offices require a cancellation_reason id. Scope: bookings.create.own (own bookings) or bookings.delete.others. Clearooms API: DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: clearooms_get_current_user · Private data: clearooms_get_current_user, clearooms_list_offices, clearooms_list_bookings, clearooms_list_my_bookings, clearooms_create_desk_booking · Public sink: clearooms_get_current_user, clearooms_create_desk_booking · Destructive: clearooms_cancel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: clearooms_get_current_user · Private data: clearooms_get_current_user, clearooms_list_offices, clearooms_list_bookings, clearooms_list_my_bookings, clearooms_create_desk_booking · Public sink: clearooms_get_current_user, clearooms_create_desk_booking · Destructive: clearooms_cancel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
